name: Sorcerous Society
source: Letters of the Damned #4, Grade 2a warband, converted from mordheimer.net (/docs/warbands/grade-2a-warbands/sorcerous-society) on 2026-10-10.

heroSlots.notes: The master wizard leading the society. Each warband must have exactly one Magus.

specialRules.note: Randomly generates two spells from one Elemental lore (Water, Fire, Earth or Air; not yet in the app, see spells.txt) or from Lesser Magic.

heroSlots.notes: Sword-arms hired to protect the society's wizards. 0-2. Cannot become the Leader.

specialRules.name: Not a Leader
specialRules.description: Can never become the warband's Leader. His Leadership is used only for his own tests, including Rout tests after the Leader is out of action.

specialRules.name: Body Guard
specialRules.description: If within 2" of a Wizard and not in close combat, he takes missile fire aimed at the Wizard and intercepts charges aimed at the Wizard, moving immediately if needed. He needs a logical path, so he cannot protect a Wizard on a different floor.

specialRules.note: Randomly generates one spell from one Elemental lore (Water, Fire, Earth or Air; not yet in the app, see spells.txt) or from Lesser Magic.

specialRules.name: Respect Your Betters
specialRules.description: A Mage may never know more spells than the Leader. If he does, he must duel the Leader (the Leader controlled by another player); the loser leaves the warband.

henchmenTypes.notes: Apprentices with raw magical potential but no training yet. 0-5. Unlike most henchmen they may carry special items such as relics or lucky charms.

specialRules.name: Harnessed
specialRules.description: On a That Lad's Got Talent result the model gains the Wizard skill. Alternatively it may keep its henchman advancement and randomly generate a spell, or use the Hero advancement roll.

henchmenTypes.notes: Hired muscle and servants of the society. Any number.

specialRules.name: Prove that Talent
specialRules.description: On a That Lad's Got Talent result a Grunt may become either a mundane Hero or an Untrained. A second such result lets him become a Wizard.

exclusiveEquipment.name: Wizard's Staff
exclusiveEquipment.rulesText: Close combat, Strength as user. Parry: may parry like a sword. Two-handed: no shield, buckler or second weapon in close combat (a shield still gives +1 armour save against shooting). Concussion: on the injury table, results of 2-4 count as Stunned.

exclusiveEquipment.name: Familiar (Sorcerous Society)
exclusiveEquipment.restriction: Heroes only; one per Wizard. Cost 20 + 2D6 gc (listed as 20 gc on the warband list).
exclusiveEquipment.rulesText: Choose Dog, Cat, Raven or Viper. Counts as equipment, but if taken out of action roll for injury as a Henchman. Does not count towards warband size or Rout tests. If it dies or leaves, search for a replacement using the rarity rules. Shooters targeting it are at -1 BS. Dog: M6 WS4 S3 T3 W1 I4 A1 Ld5; Loyal, immune to Fear within 6" of its Wizard; Sniff, the warband gets one extra exploration die, usable in place of a surviving Hero's roll. Cat: M6 WS4 S2 T2 W1 I6 A1 Ld5; Go for the Eyes, if both its attacks wound in a round the enemy is blinded and cannot fight back until its next turn, if only one wounds the enemy is at -1 WS and BS until its next turn. Raven: M2 WS2 S1 T1 W1 I4 A1 Ld5; Fly, flies 12" anywhere; I See You, spells may target models within range of either the Wizard or the Raven. Viper: M3 WS4 S2/4 T1 W1 I5 A1 Ld5; Poison, a natural 6 to hit wounds automatically with no armour save, other hits are S4 against poison-susceptible targets (S2 if immune); Coiled and Ready, Lightning Reflexes. None of the familiars has a BS.

specialRules: Keep it Secret Keep it Safe: The warband cannot hire any Hired Sword or Dramatis Personae with the Wizard ability, except the High Elf Mage. For other Hired Swords the warband counts as a Human Mercenary warband. | The Vagaries of Magic: If a Wizard rolls a natural double 1 when casting, roll 2D6 on the Magical Failure table. 2: mutates into a Chaos Spawn and is removed from the roster; 3: becomes subject to Stupidity, rolling a D6 after each battle with the effect ending on a 2+; 4: cannot cast any spells this battle; 5–6: the spell hits the wizard himself, with details decided by the player to his left; 7: no further effect; 8–9: thrown D6" in a random direction and knocked down; 10–11: cannot cast in his next shooting phase, though missile weapons still work; 12: gains a free mutation of his choice from the Possessed mutation list (rulebook p.76).
